content.comment_body: Has anyone encountered text corruption during installation on a Windows 10 PC? I thought the issue might be connected to Java, so I removed my Java installation, rebooted, and tried installing [product_name]. The attached image shows the outcome. Any advice would be appreciated!

Hello, I haven't seen this kind of mixed display before. If you have an installation DVD for [product_name], you can navigate to the folder for your operating system, such as Windows. For Windows, run setup.bat from this location as an Administrator to check if that resolves the issue. Hope this helps.

If anyone else experiences this, my solution was to uninstall the Arial font and then update via the official Microsoft site [url]. Uninstalling the font might not be necessary, but I didn't verify if skipping that step would work.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced text corruption issues while installing [product_name] on Windows 10. The cause was unclear, and troubleshooting included steps like uninstalling Java, running the installer with administrator privileges, and updating or removing system fonts. System configuration played a role, and users needed to try multiple solutions to complete the installation successfully.
